title: Concept: Tomcat container stack in a response
description: An Apache Tomcat container exception class name in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: Container stack traces name the connector, the valve chain and often absolute deployment paths, which tells an attacker the exact server build and where the application lives on disk.
applicability: Paths and class names narrow the attack to a specific Tomcat version and deployment layout.
risk: Stack details belong in the log; the response only needs a correlation id.
